grants.description: Verify your identity using your Government Gateway credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link to your tax records before processing the refund claim

grants.description: Access your PAYE employment and tax payment records for the current tax year
grants.purpose: To verify employment details, calculate tax paid and owed, and determine refund amount

grants.description: Provide details from your P45 form including total pay and tax paid
grants.purpose: To confirm employment end date and calculate correct tax position for refund

grants.description: Provide bank account details for refund payment
grants.purpose: To send your tax refund payment directly to your bank account

grants.description: Declare other sources of income and confirm you are not returning to work before April 5th
grants.purpose: To ensure accurate refund calculation and confirm eligibility for P50 refund

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC or withdraw through your Government Gateway account
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before completion. Already-processed refunds cannot be reversed through consent revocation.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide bank account details without explicit user confirmation of each digit. Agent cannot declare income sources without direct user attestation. Agent cannot sign the final declaration on your behalf - you must review and confirm all details are correct.
